claim_text: He says he is troubled and feels a caution and travail over the nation, and praying over America and Europe he sees surprise attacks and black swan events about to happen, specifically in Europe.
quote: I see surprise attacks, black swan events about to happen in Europe
falsify_match: A major unexpected attack in Europe.
falsify_miss: None. Black swan is by definition unforeseeable, so almost any event would be claimed.

claim_text: It is Europe specifically and South America specifically, with the Spanish community and the Europeans, less so America, and it was major in Europe with Rome named.
quote: It was not as much as America
falsify_match: Attacks concentrated in Europe and South America rather than America.
falsify_miss: The pattern goes the other way. Naming Rome is the only specific placing.

claim_text: Asked what comes first he answers watch Cuba, that it is dark, that Cuba will go dark and is about to go dark.
quote: Cuba will go dark. Cuba is about to go dark
falsify_match: A national Cuban blackout after this date.
falsify_miss: None. Island-wide blackouts had already occurred repeatedly before he said it.

claim_text: After the major event a spring of new growth that has not been there for decades comes straight up out of the middle with green on every side and a stalk, and the darkness on the island starts glowing with a white electric light all around the edge.
quote: That which has not been there for decades will come straight up
falsify_match: Visible economic recovery across Cuba after an upheaval.
falsify_miss: None. The glow is an image without a threshold attached.

claim_text: In the still of the night and in the darkness he will liberate the people of Cuba with his hand on it, protecting the troops and the president, and he will remove this bloodline and the name, with a new leader rising.
quote: I'm going to liberate the people of Cuba in the darkness
falsify_match: A night operation removing the Cuban leadership.
falsify_miss: None. The bloodline and the name are the specific parts.

claim_text: A new leader rises with the Secretary of State helping, bringing a spring of economic growth, with Cuban cigars banded in yellow, trade with the United States again to establish a stronger Cuba, and an auto industry with cars going over.
quote: I see a Cuban it has a yellow band around it
falsify_match: Cuban cigar trade with America reopened.
falsify_miss: None. The earliest telling of the banded cigars, and that import has been barred since 1962.

claim_text: He sees F-150 trucks, Ford trucks going to Cuba, and says it is very clear.
quote: I see F-150 trucks. Ford trucks going to Cuba
falsify_match: American vehicles sold into Cuba.
falsify_miss: None. The earliest telling of the Ford trucks, and such sales are barred under the embargo.

claim_text: He points to a named broadcaster's message about salvation as the Lord saying he would use him in these last days, then reads that the president has hinted America will turn to Cuba after Iran and says that is the two at once he told them about.
quote: I'll use him. I'm going to use him in these last days
falsify_match: That broadcaster taking up a public ministry.
falsify_miss: He does not. He also reads the Cuba headline as the two-at-once fulfilment, which it is not.

claim_text: He says he must be careful so the men and women are protected, that the Lord said many times Cuba is next and that man is going down, and that they will raise up a major leader with the Secretary of State who brings great revival, stability and financial growth to Cuba for the first time in decades.
quote: Cuba's next. That man is going down
falsify_match: The Cuban leader removed and replaced by a reformer.
falsify_miss: He remains. Withholding detail for operational security removes what could be checked.

claim_text: God is not done with Mexico and those areas, and a major revival is coming in the Hispanic population, while the Cuban leader mourns the Ayatollah from what looks like a bunker with a flag on the wall.
quote: a major revival in the Spanish community
falsify_match: Measurable church growth among Hispanic populations.
falsify_miss: None. He reads a bunker into the background of a broadcast, saying it kind of looks like one.

claim_text: The Mexican president's days are numbered and she is right after, removed with the cartel going down with mercenary groups, and a major Holy Ghost wave hits Mexico in the days and months ahead and throughout South America, Brazil, Colombia and Venezuela.
quote: I saw a major Holy Ghost wave hitting Mexico
falsify_match: The Mexican president removed early and cartels dismantled.
falsify_miss: She serves her term to 2030. Mercenary groups is the specific mechanism he names.

claim_text: The bad regime is shaken and the people have a liberation like the children of Israel, but he says you will not see a lot of this in the news, only signs of it in the spirit realm, with angels sent to North Korea where people are being tortured in prisons.
quote: You will not see a lot of this in the news
falsify_match: Reported upheaval in North Korea.
falsify_miss: None. He removes the test in advance by saying it will not be in the news.

claim_text: Angelic beings are sent to deliver the North Korean people who will have an experience like never before, North Korea is reached for the kingdom with a manifestation of glory, the dictator and his family are dealt with, and a mighty move of God comes on China, South Korea and Japan.
quote: Nor Korea will be reached for the kingdom of God
falsify_match: Open Christian practice in North Korea.
falsify_miss: None. North Korea would be the clean test, since nothing there could be missed if it happened.

claim_text: The North Korean leader said he would provide Iran with one thing that will annihilate them forever, which he calls a foolish decision, and the Chinese leader is deciding the timing on Taiwan, where he keeps seeing a three day window similar to Venezuela.
quote: I keep seeing a 3-day window of when
falsify_match: A three day Chinese operation against Taiwan.
falsify_miss: None, or a long conflict. The bound is three days here and two elsewhere.

claim_text: Praying over Taiwan and the Asian community, and over the hidden underground missile silos and bunkers where the missiles are harboured, that their intelligence would find every cave and every hiding place.
quote: these missile bunkers that they're hiding and harboring these missiles
falsify_match: Concealed missile sites located and disclosed.
falsify_miss: None. Iran's underground missile bases have been publicly displayed for years.

claim_text: He saw Pakistan trying to rally against America and joining up with Iran in the days ahead, sending in military troops to help, and says you might as well label it a world war.
quote: Pakistan started sending in military troops to help out with Iran
falsify_match: Pakistani troops deployed to Iran.
falsify_miss: None deployed. That would be unmistakable if it happened.

claim_text: He points to the Pakistani ambassador to Russia saying Iran's supreme leader was widely respected and loved in Pakistan, and says the Lord told him to watch Pakistan and not take his eye off it because Pakistan is bad, as with the device under the ground in Cuba they would try to use like Hiroshima.
quote: Watch Pakistan. Don't take your eye off this
falsify_match: Pakistan acting against American interests over Iran.
falsify_miss: None. A diplomat's condolence message is what he offers as the confirmation.

claim_text: Reading that the people of Pakistan feel the pain of the brotherly people, he says he told them they would try to come to the aid in the days ahead and that they had prayed the Pakistani government would stay out of it because this is going to get ugly.
quote: I told you they would try to come to the aid in the days ahead
falsify_match: The earlier recordings name Pakistan before this reporting.
falsify_miss: They do not. He offers a statement of condolence as the aid he foresaw.

claim_text: Israel killed a missile from space, which he ties to the Lord saying they would see weapons never seen before and that Israel has weapons doing things never seen, though he says he does not know whether this is one of them.
quote: Israel has weapons and doing things we've never seen before
falsify_match: A genuinely novel Israeli capability disclosed.
falsify_miss: None. He says himself maybe we have seen that before, which is the honest note.

claim_text: A fake video with two million views, and he recalls saying that in the days ahead there would be so much fake AI news that it becomes almost impossible, so that everything has to be fact checked.
quote: they'll have so much fake AI news
falsify_match: Synthetic media becoming pervasive enough to require universal verification.
falsify_miss: It does not. AI-generated video was already widespread when he said it.

claim_text: This is the beginning of a mighty hand removing dictators from their seats of power, with a wave of glory on the nations and continents, the underground church of Iran rising up, and the greatest harvest of souls the world has seen, though he says they need the signs and wonders.
quote: a great uh mighty hand removing dictators from their seat of power
falsify_match: A run of authoritarian governments falling with church growth following.
falsify_miss: None. Dictators are not counted, so a single fall anywhere would be claimed.

claim_text: The greatest manifestation of the glory, greater than Azusa Street, with Azusa Streets all over the place rather than one location, and the named university and its arena becoming a glory dome.
quote: The Oru will become Glory Dome
falsify_match: Sustained revival meetings filling that arena.
falsify_miss: None. He names his own local campus, which makes this one of the more checkable revival claims.

claim_text: Sympathiser lone wolf attacks as in Austin, with prayer over New Orleans, Nashville and Las Vegas, and bold and highlighted over the largest church in America and over named megachurch pastors and their churches, and over Tampa.
quote: sympathizers lone wolf attacks like we saw in Austin
falsify_match: An attack at one of the named churches or cities.
falsify_miss: None. He says he tries not to name names, then names four ministries.

claim_text: He had been told to pray over the helicopters, and points to reports across Texas of helicopters flying low that residents cannot explain, saying they are Chinooks practising and getting ready for phase two.
quote: they're getting ready for phase two
falsify_match: An operation following those flights.
falsify_miss: None. Low-level military training over Texas is routine and reported most years.

claim_text: A clip about a hundred per cent fatality rate and China playing around with rats, which he says matches his word that the next one would be with rats and the next plague would be of rats.
quote: the next plague will be of rats
falsify_match: A rodent-borne outbreak traced to Chinese work.
falsify_miss: None. He does not know who the man in the clip is and takes the figure at face value.

claim_text: They practise with rats and release them, and it spreads throughout Europe with no cure so that anybody who gets it goes home, while people in white suits with white ties and a honey glow all over them lay hands on the sick.
quote: when they release the rats it will spread throughout Europe
falsify_match: A rodent-borne epidemic across Europe with a religious healing movement alongside.
falsify_miss: Neither. No cure and anybody who gets it dies is the extreme form of the claim.

claim_text: The cries of the underground church in Iran are seen and the dawning of a new day is at hand for them after so much persecution, with the sun rising on a new day concerning them.
quote: the dawning of a new day is at hand for you
falsify_match: Religious freedom in Iran.
falsify_miss: None. At hand carries no date.

claim_text: He warns that a scammer impersonating him asked a woman for fifty thousand dollars, says he is not a financial adviser and will never ask for a dime, and points to the links in the description instead.
quote: please do not give $50,000 to the scammer
falsify_match: Nothing. A warning about impersonation.
falsify_miss: Nothing. No forward claim is made.

claim_text: He shows an Iranian announcement boasting about what they have underground and saying they are about to use it all.
quote: This is Iran bragging that they have all this underground
falsify_match: Not his claim. He is reading their announcement.
falsify_miss: Not his claim. Recorded so the boast is not counted as a word.

claim_text: Bunkers protected way down deep underground, and the more they are attacked the further down they move the things they do not want annihilated, which he describes as like an ant den.
quote: the further they would put some of their stuff down
falsify_match: Deep facilities found holding relocated material.
falsify_miss: None found. This is the earliest telling of the material held under the ground.

claim_text: The Lord said Macron will rise up to be a tyrant in the days ahead, and he notes that Macron is not acting like a tyrant now, only like someone who wants to be involved.
quote: he will raise up to be a tyrant in the days ahead
falsify_match: Macron taking authoritarian powers.
falsify_miss: He does not. He concedes here that nothing of the kind is happening yet.

claim_text: Turkey rising up with massive war drums beating in the Black Sea, and the Turkish leader putting on a Count Dracula cape with a massive collar, a brooch and a white shirt.
quote: I saw he put on a Count Dracula cape
falsify_match: Turkey moving militarily in the Black Sea.
falsify_miss: It does not. The cape is the image he returns to across every telling of this.

claim_text: Unconventional weapons of war like we have never seen used by Putin, Turkey blocking the waterway into the Black Sea, Russia annihilating the Ukrainian president, and the words world war three written large above Ukraine and spreading all over Europe.
quote: unconventional the uh weapons of war like we've never seen before being used by Putin
falsify_match: Russia using a weapon of a kind not seen before.
falsify_miss: None. Unconventional is not defined, though the Zelensky killing and the strait closure are.

claim_text: Turkey takes over and makes it impossible to get into the Black Sea to help Russia, and the North Korean leader sends tens of thousands of troops to Ukraine and helps Iran in the days ahead.
quote: I saw Kim Jong-un sending tens of thousands of
falsify_match: Tens of thousands of North Korean troops in Ukraine and support to Iran.
falsify_miss: The numbers stay in the thousands. North Korean deployments have been reported in the low thousands, which is the base rate.

claim_text: The North Korean leader is flexing and becoming paranoid because he thinks he is next, which he says he prays is true, and he links it back to the Olympics and the satanic ceremony in the arch that he says was conjuring the Hitler spirit.
quote: He started to become paranoid because he thinks he's next
falsify_match: The North Korean leader removed.
falsify_miss: He remains. Paranoia is not observable from outside.

claim_text: The Islamic world realises how close the end is and is preparing, needing this war with Israel and America to stir it up and bring forth their Islamic savior, during Ramadan, which is why he is praying over American soil and over Easter.
quote: They needed this war with Israel and with America, the great Satan
falsify_match: An Iranian escalation timed to Ramadan and framed in Mahdi terms.
falsify_miss: None. The Ramadan window closed in March 2026.

claim_text: Thunder shook the whole house as a sign emphasising that a storm is coming, and the Lord said the Chinese leader has made his decision and is getting ready to implement the plan concerning Taiwan, which took three days.
quote: Xiinping has made his decision
falsify_match: A Chinese move on Taiwan following this.
falsify_miss: None. He treats thunder over his own house as an emphasis on the word.

claim_text: It took three days and was the same kind of thing that happened with the Venezuelan leader, coming in like stealth in the middle of the night with not much of a fight, though he believes prayer can change or delay it.
quote: They came in like stealth in the middle of the night
falsify_match: A three day stealth operation taking Taiwan.
falsify_miss: None, or a long war. He allows that prayer can delay it, which covers a miss.

claim_text: He says he does not add to or take away, and plays back his own earlier word that he saw a great war breaking out between Israel and Iran in the days ahead, asking whether they could be there now.
quote: I saw great war breaking out with Israel and Iran in the days ahead
falsify_match: The earlier recording exists and predates the war.
falsify_miss: It does not, or it postdates the escalation. He is replaying his own clip here rather than giving a fresh word.

claim_text: In the replayed clip, gas shortages bring oil to two hundred dollars a barrel with big money stimulating the American economy when Middle East production is hit, lasting only a season or a window, with drill baby drill, pipelines opened and the Nord Stream deal talked about again.
quote: I saw pipelines being opened up, being worked out
falsify_match: Nord Stream renegotiated and reopened.
falsify_miss: It is not. This is a clip of his own earlier broadcast, so the original telling predates the corpus window here.

claim_text: The same clip continues with great antisemitism because people are angry at Israel, and Russia, Syria and Turkey wanting to retaliate with war, and he adds that he does not believe they have changed it through prayer.
quote: I saw them getting upset in the Middle East against
falsify_match: Those three states moving against Israel.
falsify_miss: They do not. He says the prayer has not changed it, which removes the usual escape.

claim_text: He does not label himself, and when he sees part of a word coming to pass he looks at the rest, noting it was a window and not a door, and that Venezuela and Iran were trying to be part of BRICS while the president strategically eliminates the new BRICS system so it becomes weak.
quote: eliminating the new bricks system
falsify_match: BRICS currency plans collapsing under American pressure.
falsify_miss: They advance. A common BRICS currency was never close, which makes its failure the base case.

claim_text: BRICS needed funding from Venezuela, Iran's oil and African nations backing the currency, and the president attacks that so the dollar is strong and BRICS goes away, while Macron and others try to raise a greater war in Europe to support the euro.
quote: It makes the dollar strong and it makes it where they don't have a bricks
falsify_match: BRICS funding collapsing and the euro under strain from a European war.
falsify_miss: Neither. Two separate outcomes are packed together here.

claim_text: He heard the Lord say it would be a window and not a door, unlike Cuba, Mexico and Venezuela which get leaders and revival over a longer time frame, with Iran flipping quickly back to another figure like the Ayatollah, and he prays for the safety of the man he names.
quote: I told you this would be a window, not a door
falsify_match: A short Iranian opening followed by a hardline restoration.
falsify_miss: A lasting opening, or none at all. The contrast with Cuba and Mexico is the checkable part.

claim_text: He sees them dividing to one side or the other and says he does not understand it because he is not Muslim, and sees a leader in Pakistan with a white turban who is very upset, saying they want the Mahdi to come.
quote: THEY SAID, WE WANT THE MI to come
falsify_match: A Pakistani leader publicly invoking the Mahdi against Israel or America.
falsify_miss: None. He says himself he does not understand the divisions he is describing.
